title: 第1462章 造化仙王第1461章 极道真武
slug: 投资天命族人我实力是全族总和
content_zh:
随后，长明大帝拱手道：“那我便去北方界群走一趟。”
“那里几处防线已经支撑太久，也该让那些魔物付出代价了。”
素华大帝与其余诸帝也先后向姜道玄告辞。
很快，一道道帝光划过星海，分别朝五方界群而去。
直到最后一人离开。
现场重回安静。
姜道玄独自立于星海中央。
他抬起头，目光缓缓扫过眼前的星海。
“该结束了。”
说着，抬起手掌。
一缕时空本源自指尖浮现。
他并未直接将力量铺满整个天墟。
毕竟五方界群过于浩瀚，其中的时空通道数量众多，位置也各不相同，若要将其封死，必须逐一锁定，再斩断它们与魔域之间的联系。
姜道玄闭上双眼。
神念顺着天墟的时空脉络不断延伸。
片刻后。
他感应到了距离赤岚星域最近的一条通道。
那条通道隐藏在一颗残破古星内部，正不断有魔气从裂缝中涌出。
姜道玄并指轻点。
指尖的神光瞬间跨越星海，落入那颗古星中。

嗡——
时空裂缝骤然震动。
通道内的魔族尚未反应过来，周围空间便开始迅速收拢。
为首的魔族准帝出手，试图维持时空裂缝。
可力量刚刚触及裂缝，便被时空之力压了回去。
“怎么回事？”
“通道为何正在闭合？”
另一尊魔族准帝脸色阴沉，接连轰出数道魔光。
然而，毫无作用。
在他们惊疑不定的目光下，时空通道逐渐收缩，最终彻底消失。
“有人封住了通道。”
“难道是那方界域的强者所为？”
众魔虽惊怒，却并未立刻联想到其他地方。
毕竟在此前的连番大战中，部分时空通道同样遭到过天墟强者的封镇。
因此，一条通道失去联系，并不算罕见。
可他们不知道，这仅仅只是开始。
姜道玄在封住第一条时空通道后，立即以神念沿着天墟时空继续延伸，很快便锁定了下一处坐标。
时空之力穿过一片片星域。
第二条通道随之闭合。
紧接着是第三条、第四条。

一条条埋藏于南方界群的时空通道，被姜道玄逐一找出。
.........
正当时空通道被接连封闭时。
魔域深处。
此前跨界接引幽罗的四尊魔神，已是退回所属魔界。
content_en:
Afterwards, Emperor Changming cupped his hands and said, "Then I will go to the Northern Boundary Group."
"The defense lines there have been held up for too long, and it's time to make those monsters pay the price."
Emperor Suhua and the other emperors also said goodbye to Jiang Daoxuan one after another.
Soon, rays of imperial light crossed the sea of ​​​​stars and headed towards the five realm groups.
Until the last person leaves.
The scene returned to silence.
Jiang Daoxuan stood alone in the center of the sea of ​​stars.
He raised his head and slowly scanned the sea of ​​stars in front of him.
"It's time to finish."
As he spoke, he raised his palms.
A trace of the origin of time and space emerges from the fingertips.
He did not directly spread his power over the entire Tianxu.
After all, the Five Directions Realm Group is too vast, with a large number of time and space channels in them, and their locations are also different. If you want to seal them, you must lock them one by one and then cut off the connection between them and the Demon Realm.
Jiang Daoxuan closed his eyes.
Divine thoughts continue to extend along the time and space veins of Tianxu.
After a while.
He sensed the passage closest to the Chilan Star Territory.
That passage was hidden inside a broken ancient star, and demonic energy was constantly pouring out of the cracks.
Jiang Daoxuan pointed lightly.
The divine light at his fingertips instantly crossed the sea of ​​stars and fell into the ancient star.
Buzz——
The cracks in time and space suddenly shook.
Before the demons in the passage could react, the surrounding space began to shrink rapidly.
The demon quasi-emperor headed by him took action to try to maintain the rift in time and space.
But as soon as the power touched the crack, it was pushed back by the power of time and space.
"What's going on?"
"Why is the passage closing?"
The other demon quasi-emperor had a gloomy face and blasted out several rays of magic light one after another.
However, nothing works.
Under their doubtful gazes, the space-time channel gradually shrank and eventually disappeared completely.
"Someone blocked the passage."
"Could it be the work of a strong man from that realm?"
Although the demons were frightened and angry, they did not immediately think of other places.
After all, in the previous series of battles, some time and space channels were also blocked by the strong men of Tianxu.
Therefore, it is not uncommon for a channel to lose contact.
But they don't know that this is just the beginning.
After Jiang Daoxuan sealed the first space-time passage, he immediately used his spiritual thoughts to continue extending along the Tianxu space-time, and soon locked the next coordinates.
The power of time and space passes through the star fields.
The second channel then closed.
Then there are the third and fourth items.
The space-time passages buried in the southern boundary group were discovered one by one by Jiang Daoxuan.
.........
Just when the space-time channels are being closed one after another.
Deep in the Demon Realm.
The four demon gods who had previously crossed the border to welcome You Luo have returned to their respective demon realms.
